new_map_record.question: Bringer uses Spirits May Yet Dream to turn an unearned Fear Card in the Fear deck face-up. Does turning it face-up immediately earn that card or let players resolve its Fear effect now, or must it still be earned and resolved normally?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer uses Spirits May Yet Dream to turn an unearned Fear Card in the Fear deck face-up. Does turning it face-up immediately earn that card or let players resolve its Fear effect now, or must it still be earned and resolved normally?
required_facts: Turning the card face-up does not itself earn the card.
Turning it face-up does not resolve its Fear effect or grant early resolution; normal earning and resolution still apply.
